notes.title: Adventure Campaign DLC
notes.notes:
Dual Wield Software would like to present our newest addition to The Land of Glass, the Adventure campaign! Follow Myna and Baya as they set out to write a travelogue of their first trip through Vitrerran. It's the end of the world, and they hope they can find something interesting to write about. 

This free DLC includes: 

A full new, story-driven campaign 
Dozens of new cards 
A quest system 
New characters 
New villains
Bug fixes
UI Updates

notes.title: The Land of Glass OST is on Youtube
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we've put The Land of Glass OST onto Youtube. We're looking at a way to give the .mp3s out for free, though if you buy the game, you get the .wav files with it. You have to dig through some of the folders, but they are there and not encrypted for anyone that wants to listen to them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V9AiBNHRYiI

Cheers!

~DWS
